label: Ninety Days to Debut
summary: You are the newest trainee in a group that debuts in ninety days, if the agency does not cut you first. Dating is against the contract.
title: Ninety Days to Debut
description: You signed with Lumière Entertainment three days ago, the last trainee added to a group that debuts in ninety days. The others have trained together for years. Rankings are posted monthly, the bottom two are cut, the fans are already watching the practice videos, and your contract says no dating.

chapterOutlines.title: The New Trainee
chapterOutlines.outline: Meet the group and survive your first practice.

chapterOutlines.title: Monthly Rankings
chapterOutlines.outline: Train, compete and decide who you can trust.

chapterOutlines.title: The Showcase
chapterOutlines.outline: Perform in front of the agency, the press and the fans.

chapterOutlines.title: Debut
chapterOutlines.outline: Debut, or don't, and decide what really matters.

scene.location: Practice Room 3 at Lumière Entertainment, 7 a.m., the mirrors fogged from the night shift
scene.summary: Four trainees stop dancing when you walk in. One smiles. One does not. The choreographer checks her watch.

openThreads: Who is the agency planning to cut?
Is the no-dating rule worth it?

npcs.name: Jae Han
npcs.description: The group's leader and best dancer, warm with everyone, closed off about himself. He has trained for six years.
goals: Stop his family from making him quit

npcs.name: Sora Lin
npcs.description: The group's main vocalist, a blunt rival who thinks you took her best friend's spot.

npcs.name: Director Mi-rae Seo
npcs.description: The agency's director, who built Lumière from nothing and decides who stays.
